info.name: LurePilot AI
info.description: Backend API collection for LurePilot AI MVP, including fishing spots, lures, fish library, plans, sessions, AI recommendations and IPMA weather snapshots.

request.description: Returns dashboard counters plus upcoming plans, active sessions, recent sessions, recent catches and recent weather snapshots.

request.description: Returns only PLAN recommendation history for the selected fishing plan, ordered newest first.

Returns the latest version of the AI plan recommendation for a fishing plan. Normal responses include version, latest, confidence, confidenceScore and confidenceReason; rawResponse is only available in debug.
Debug endpoint with contextJson and rawResponse. Use normal endpoints for app responses.
Returns the session adjustment recommendation history for a fishing session.
Returns the latest session adjustment recommendation for a fishing session.
Returns the latest session review recommendation for a fishing session.
Records whether the user followed PLAN_A, PLAN_B, PLAN_C or a session adjustment, plus result, success, rating and notes.

request.description: Returns execution tracking history for one AI recommendation.
Returns recommendation execution records linked to a fishing plan.
Returns recommendation execution records linked to a fishing session.
Returns basic analytics using stored sessions, catches, session lures and recommendation execution tracking.
